places.note: The brownie with chocolate ganache is the best brownie I have had in Seattle! It's a perfect cake brownie with a rich delicious chocolate ganache on top. This is coming from someone who is not a big fan of sugar. I would highly recommend this dessert place!

places.name: Yeobo Cafe and Bar
places.note: The chicken salad Sando is so delicious!! It's so unique and flavorful than any chicken salad sandwich I have tried. It has a very nice Asian umami taste. The zesty lime and Serrano dressing with the pickled mint has such a refreshing flavor. This is my second sandwich I have tried here and both times the sandwiches were 10/10. They flavors are unique and different than sandwiches you will find elsewhere. I'm looking forward to trying more sandwiches. Good spot for getting work done. It's lively and bright and the music is not too loud.
places.address: 2332 E Madison St, Seattle, WA 98112, United States

places.name: Pacha Collective
places.note: I had the butternut squash curry bowl and the earl grey lavender matcha. Both items were good. The butternut squash curry bowl tastes like butternut squash pieces in a Thai red curry but milder. All in all it's decent. The cafe is a Good place to do remote work from. Has a lively, bright atmosphere
